sections.heading: What is a managed website for a plumbing, HVAC or electrical company?
body: A managed website for a plumbing, HVAC or electrical company is a professionally designed website that SynergyFirst Digital hosts, maintains and supports for one monthly fee, with no upfront design fee. It is built around how people look for these trades: the service they need, the area you cover, and a fast way to call or request service.
Plans start at $249 per month with no activation fee, and every business can see a free, private preview before paying.

sections.heading: Why plumbing, HVAC and electrical websites lose jobs they should win
sections.intro: Most searches for these trades are urgent and made on a phone. These are the gaps we see most often.

items.title: The phone number is hard to find
items.body: When a pipe has burst or the heating has failed, a number buried in a menu sends the customer to the next company.

items.title: Every trade is squeezed onto one page
items.body: A drain, a furnace and a fuse box are different jobs. Without a clear path for each, visitors are unsure you handle theirs.

items.title: Emergency and routine work look the same
items.body: Urgent calls and planned jobs need different routes, so each customer knows what to do next.

items.title: The service area is unclear
items.body: If visitors cannot quickly tell whether you cover their town, they do not enquire.

items.title: No easy way to book or request service
items.body: Not every customer wants to phone. A short request form captures the ones who would rather write.

items.title: Trust is left to chance
items.body: Licence and insurance details, reviews and past work belong where customers look for reassurance, especially for work done inside a home.

sections.heading: What we build into a plumbing, HVAC or electrical website
sections.intro: Every site is custom-designed around how your customers choose a home services company.

items.title: Click-to-call on every page
items.body: Your number stays one tap away on phones, so urgent customers can reach you without searching.

items.title: A separate path for each trade
items.body: Clear sections for plumbing, heating and cooling, and electrical work, each with a call or service request beside it.

items.title: Emergency and scheduled service options
items.body: Give urgent and planned jobs their own route, so each customer knows what to do next.

items.title: Service-area clarity
items.body: State where you work, so visitors can see straight away that you cover their location.

items.title: A home for photos, reviews and credentials
items.body: Space for the licences, reviews and project photos you can genuinely show, placed where customers look for reassurance.

items.title: A simple service-request form
items.body: A short, accessible form where customers describe the problem, so you can call back or plan the visit.
